title: Define
subtitle: Research, Planning & Strategy
description: Understanding the problem starts with research, analysis and strategic planning, aligning user needs, business goals and project requirements around a clear direction.

title: Design
subtitle: Ideation, UX & Visual Design
description: Insights take shape through concepts, user flows and intuitive interfaces, balancing usability, visual craft and business objectives.

title: Prototype
subtitle: Interaction, Testing & Refinement
description: Design moves into implementation through close collaboration, careful refinement and attention to responsive behaviour, interaction details and overall experience quality. Ideas become tangible through interactive prototypes, allowing key flows, behaviours and assumptions to be tested and refined before development begins.

title: Develop
subtitle: Web Development & Implementation
description: Approved designs and prototypes are translated into responsive, production-ready experiences using modern web technologies, with careful attention to performance, accessibility, interactions and design fidelity.

title: Deliver
subtitle: Launch, Measure & Improve
description: The final experience is prepared for release through quality assurance, final refinements and implementation checks. After launch, feedback, performance insights and real-world usage help identify opportunities for optimisation, iteration and continuous improvement.
